programme.desc: As Jerry settles in to watch a boxing match on TV, George and Elaine return with his borrowed car and concoct a wild story to explain why it's developed a clanking noise.

programme.desc: When Kramer invites himself over once too often, Jerry demands he return the spare set of keys Jerry loaned to him, which virtually ends their open-door friendship. Distraught and overwrought, Kramer heads west to California.

programme.desc: With Elaine in Europe, Jerry asks George to accompany him on a trip to LA and The Tonight Show, while there they will try to locate Kramer. Stars Jerry Seinfeld, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Jason Alexander and Michael Richards.

programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay want to make each other a rakhi, a protection bracelet. But first they need to decide who is the best protector!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Nine Times Table shows how you can add ten and take one away, to make Nine's friends.

programme.title: The Makery
programme.desc: Nim and The Makery go on a nature trail adventure. They make a flip flop picture, a banana mouse and a tree costume.

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: Traditional Owners Connie and her granddaughter, Gleesyanna, take Clarence on a journey through Kakadu's incredible plant life and introduce him to the six seasons of Kakadu.

programme.title: Play School
programme.desc: Michelle and Kaeng make baby dinosaur puppets, then explore the Creature Carousel in the Play School Dino Museum. They tell the story of Tui the Triceratops and her twins. 'Through The Windows' we go on a dino egg hunt!

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Dance along to the Limbo, explore feelings with Anthony, and sing a shapes song. Enjoy Food Reviews with Simon and Shirley Shawn the Unicorn, then finish with a live preschool performance of 'Round the Garden'.

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Fizzy and Suds explore dinosaurs at the museum! They ride skeletons, meet scientists, fix bones, and find out how fossils tell us what dinosaurs ate and how they lived.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: Miffy and Baby Bun are ready for their big adventure, hiking and camping in the woods! But the car has broken down, and they are stuck on the road.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Stuck in a cave during heavy rain, Ginger and the Peas find fun playing indoors for once.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 150 million years to the time of brachiosaurus - a huge plant-eating dinosaur measuring 26 metres from nose to tail.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: The crew must team up with the fabled tooth mouse El Ratoncito Perez to retrieve his stolen cap and satchel from Enrique.

programme.title: Superkitties
programme.desc: The SuperKitties must return a grand piano to Petcini, after Cat Burglar steals it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The dog and the squirrels decide to play hide and seek and Duggee finds them all except Roly.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: It's finally the day of the baby's arrival! Mummy and Daddy Pig rush to the hospital, but Peppa and George must stay with Granny and Grandpa Pig instead.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: With the baby now born, Peppa makes it her mission to find the perfect name. After many failed attempts, Peppa finally finds the perfect name with the help from the family album.

programme.title: It's Andrew!
programme.desc: It's 'rock' show and tell at Kindy School and the littlecorns have brought their very special rocks to talk about. Andrew's rock doesn't seem like much, but with a little imagination something very special is brought to life.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: It's a great train robbery as Silver Paw hijacks Lauchie's toy train so she can steal pet treats from the kitchen, while Moss plays train driver to try and bring it home.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Using her super-speed at a beach clean-up, Angela accidentally creates a giant whirlwind that threatens the event.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: When Neville thinks he sees a mermaid in the lagoon, he sets out to find her.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Pirate Robot wants to upgrade his ship stuff from the Flying Factory.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Spidey reminds Spin and Ghost-Spider to work as a team to track Rhino.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's time for a family game of hide and seek! Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys?

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programme.desc: What's making the strange noises in the cave? Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure!

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: A dragonfly steals a bee cocoon that Cosima had vowed to keep safe. Cosima and Big Lizard give chase, leading to a surprising solution with a vacuum cleaner and some sticky vines!

programme.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
programme.desc: The HexVets must save Emilios from a wicked new foe: the Creature Catchers.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea pretends she's hurt her foot, so she can break the Tatoscope at Tato Tower.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Bibi and Batwing must work together to get past the Legion of Zoom in order to deliver a new giant screen to Batcomputer.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys. But nothing can tempt her to clean up, until Dad drops the cake.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: Wizz is introducing the King at a grand event, and he wants to take his voice to the next level. After drinking a tonic to help, something unexpected happens to Wizz's voice, right before his big speech.
